When my boyfriend (now fiancé) Jeremy and I moved in together, we didn’t have a sofa or much of a budget for one. I quickly found an affordable sofa on Amazon that was the perfect “starter” sectional, but a year later we weren’t happy with it. While it was comfortable and looked great in our living room, the fabric constantly pilled, the foam needed daily fluffing, and the cushions shifted after lounging.
